name: When in a bathroom remodel should finish carpentry be scheduled?

mainEntity.name: When in a bathroom remodel should finish carpentry be scheduled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry is typically one of the final stages in a bathroom remodel, occurring after all rough plumbing, electrical, drywall, and painting are complete. This sequence protects the finished wood from damage during messy construction phases and allows for accurate measurements once walls and floors are finalized. Cabinets and vanities are installed first, followed by trim work like baseboards and door casings, and then any built-in shelving or decorative elements. This ensures a clean, precise fit and finish for all woodworking components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry is scheduled at the end of a bathroom remodel, after rough construction, drywall, and painting, to protect the wood and ensure precise fitting.
